blocks.label: Overview
paragraphs: A Better Way to Support Joint Health

Turmeric has been used for centuries for its active ingredient, curcumin, which supports a healthy inflammatory response. The trouble is, too many turmeric supplements use low quality curcumin extracts that aren't easily absorbed, and often do very little to help support joint health. Lucky for you, there's Better Turmeric®.

Better Turmeric contains HydroCurc®, one of the most bioavailable sources of curcumin in the industry. This scientifically advanced extract delivers the highest level of curcuminoids - the natural compounds in curcumin that support joint health.

With added vitamin D for immune health, and B vitamins to boost cellular energy, just two soft chews per day is all it takes to support your joint health and flexibility in the most delicious way imaginable.
We know that great nutrition changes lives. Whether you want to improve your mind, body or performance, we have the formula to help you do it. Let Force Factor help Unleash Your Potential®.
